title: The Sapphire Ascent Rite of Spun Cords
summary: The school rite of the Sapphire Ascent Academy that spins soul force into a radiant skein and winds it round a soul until it is held.

title: The Nine Halls Rite of Stilled Souls
summary: The rite of the Nine Halls that stills a soul so wholly that it cannot stir or cast and is held in a perfect hush.

title: The Lyraen Heights Rite of the Unbreakable Hold
summary: The rite of the Lyraen Heights Academy for the soul anchored to its Core that closes a hold no strain can part.

title: The Stormbreak Rite of the Storm Snare
summary: The rite of the Stormbreak Academy that lays a snare in the soul-field like a gathering storm and springs it with a burst.

title: The Oath-Voices' Rite of the Spoken Binding
summary: The rite of the Oath-Voices that closes a binding by a spoken word so that the word itself holds and seals the one who broke faith.

title: The Aerie Rite of the Open Net
summary: The rite of the Aerie Academy for the soul with a domain of its own that spreads a net across the whole domain and draws it in on any soul within.
